We're sending you back to the knennel{{sic}}!|audio = Moltenwave-21.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 21 (Formerly, [[Molten Mode|Molten]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Molten Hound''' is an enemy that first appears on Wave 22 of [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a decently high health and swift speed. Upon death, it will create a small explosion which deals 5,000 damage to units in an explosive radius of 3. ==Appereance== The '''Molten Hound''' resembles a hellish dog with crimson skin. Multiple parts of its body are replacement with cybernetic parts, which includes portions of its head, torso, tail and legs. It walks on all fours and has a mouth with very sharp teeth. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Hunter]] or [[Turret]] should be able to take care of this quite easily, due to their DPS. **The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can also be useful, due to their practically map-wide range. *Stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]], [[Brawler]] or [[Cryomancer]] can be used to slow it down, as it is quite fast. **Multiple of these towers can also be used to drop its [[Defense]], though as it is quite low this will have minimal impact on the damage it receives. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1MoltenHound.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2MoltenHound.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseHound.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexMoltenHound.png|'''Molten Hound''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:MoltenHoundDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Molten Hound''' dies |} }}}} ==Trivia== *The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]]'s current dialogue was supposed to be the same as the original dialogue for the '''Molten Hound''', but it was stopped in the middle as it was stupid. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''11 December 2024''' - [[v1.45.0]] **'''Molten Hound''' added. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **Health increased from 600 to 700. **Defense of 25% added. *'''12 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3a]] **Now appears in [[Sk8 P4rk]] Master difficulty as part of [[The Takeover Event]]. ***Has 700 health in [[Sk8 P4rk]]. **Cash given is now mode dependent. ***[[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode now gives {{Money|600}} on death. ***[[The Takeover Event]] Master difficulty gives {{Money|500}} on death. ***Default value is {{Money|5}} on death. *'''22 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3g]] **No longer appears in [[Sk8 P4rk]], as it has been removed. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **First wave appearance changed from 21 to 22. **Health decreased from 700 to 500. **Defense increased from 25% to 40%. **Speed increased from Fast (7) to Swift (10). **Cash given increased from {{Money|600}} to {{Money|900}} on death. **''Explosive Malfunction'' changed. ***Damage increased from 50 to 5,000. ***Explosion radius decreased from 6 to 3. }} {{Molten|[[Elite Boomer]]|Wave 21|Molten Hound|Wave 22|[[Molten Mech]]|Wave 23}} {{TakeoverMaster|[[Molten Necromancer]]|Wave 13|Molten Hound|Wave 14|[[Breaker4]]|Wave 15}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
